text:
### I want to cancel the update request. Will I be able to do it?
![](https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/static/media/ArrowDown.a5229ab197c918ede75c7ae811502301.svg)
A resident can cancel the update request from the ‘Requests’ space in the myAadhaar dashboard until the request is picked up for further processing. If cancelled, the amount paid will be refunded to the account within 21 days.
